Filtering:

Limitations:

  • Star history may be incomplete for repos with >40k stars (API pagination limits)
  • LLM-generated commentary is interpretive, not prescriptive
  • Weekly snapshots may miss short-lived trends%!(EXTRA string=tutorial, awesome, learning, course, book, string=vision, infra, agent, llm, rag, int=50)
